textos.Lançado em 1959 e dirigido por Otto Prem: Released in 1959 and directed by Otto Preminger, Anatomy of a Murder is a 160-minute crime and mystery drama. The plot follows Paul Biegler, a small-town former prosecutor who takes on the defense of an army lieutenant accused of killing a man after he allegedly raped his wife. To handle the case, the lawyer must apply his experience and cunning in court against an influential rival prosecutor from the capital.
textos.A experiência do longa é estruturada em: The film's experience is structured around judicial proceedings, unfolding at a detailed, measured pace over its long running time.

Among the vast majority of ratings (~91%), close to half of the accounts point to James Stewart's performance as one of the great draws. In addition, a significant share praises the construction of an engrossing courtroom drama, while a considerable number highlight the quality of the script and dialogue.
